fixed.problem: Blocking 1: the Sessions list's working row said 'Quote page · plans the session' while a task was still running, once the task had taken more than about 49 steps. The bar meanwhile said 'the coder works on ...'. Cause: sessionRunText folded only the newest 50 events of the fold's types, and task.step (one per tool call) is one of those types.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/run-indicator.test.ts 'runViews (V-1) > says in the Sessions list's working row what the bar says, however many steps the task took' (after 60 steps it got 'Quote page · plans the session')
fixed.how: sessionRunText now folds the session's whole log through the store's kept folds (new runFoldsOf(store) in run-indicator.ts). compose's run indicator uses the same map, so the list and the bar read each log once, in order, and say the same sentence. The map keeps at most 200 folds and drops the oldest first; runViews still drops the folds of ended sessions. The test also covers the wrap-up line after 60 more steps and a read with no fold kept (a fresh daemon).
fixed.check_in_the_app: live_check: 1) Start a session on a project whose first task takes many steps (a long research or writing task on the real model). 2) While that task has been running for a few minutes, open the project's Sessions tab. The working row reads the same sentence as the bar under the header, e.g. 'Quote page · the coder works on "Write the guide"'. It never reads 'plans the session' while the task runs. Bench walk A: the row and GET /running gave the same text.

fixed.problem: Blocking 2: the critic's monthly check never reached the bar live. No run.changed frame was sent when it started or ended, so the bar showed it only after a reload, and then kept showing it with Stop after it had ended. Cause: CalibrationJob runs outside the session runner and emits on no bus. The requestStart poke fired before the check's row existed, and nothing poked at its end.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'd1109-run-visible, run C > the critic's monthly check reads ...' now reads /events. It waits for a run.changed frame naming the check while it runs and an empty frame after it ends; before the fix it timed out with frames [].
fixed.how: New optional CalibrationJobDeps.onRowChanged(sessionId), called after the run's row is made and after it is ended (it never fails the run). compose passes the run indicator's poke through a late-bound pokeRunIndicator. The poke's debounce now reads clock.monotonic() instead of Date.now(), as AGENTS.md requires. Two of the review's notes on the same entry are fixed too. The check's Stop now line reads 'Stops the check at once. This month's report is not written.', not the session sentence about Ready. The tab title reads '● The critic's monthly check · Forerunner', with a project's session named first. calibration-job.test.ts asserts onRowChanged is called twice per run; run-indicator.test.tsx asserts the Stop now line and the title.
fixed.check_in_the_app: live_check (only when the monthly check runs; it cannot be triggered from the UI this month, because the schedule's first sighting marks the month): 1) With the app open on Home when the check runs (day 1 at 06:00 local by default), the bar shows 'Forerunner · the critic's monthly check on known examples' without a reload. 2) Open Stop ▾: the explanation line, Stop now with 'Stops the check at once. This month's report is not written.', and Stop all. 3) The tab title is '● The critic's monthly check · Forerunner'. 4) When the check ends, the bar goes away without a reload. Covered here at the /events boundary by the real-daemon case.

fixed.problem: Blocking 3 (C3-left-8, second half): after Cancel, the Overview's Last result, its Read aloud and the Inbox's Update line still promised '...; then your session goes on.', also after a reload. Only GET /sessions/:id applied summaryAfterWait, and only for its 'stopped' block.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'd1109-run-visible, run C: the page of a session that ended to wait (V-5) > goes on: the wait with Cancel; ...' now reads GET /projects/:id/summary (lastSession.summary and spoken) and GET /inbox messages before Cancel, after Cancel and after a restart. Before the fix, after Cancel it got 'Waits until 11:40 (your subscription's limit); then your session goes on.'.
fixed.how: New run-indicator.ts waitPromiseHolds(store, projectId, since) and resultAfterWait(store, projectId, since, text). The promise holds while the continuation or a Start for the reset is kept and no session of the project has begun since. It also holds once a continuation session began after it, because the session did go on by itself. Cancel, Stop all, or a session the person started instead end the promise, and the text then reads '...; then it runs at your next Start.'. The session page (server.ts liveSessionView, replacing the waitBlock 'stopped' test), views.ts projectSummary (Last result and spoken) and GET /inbox's message bodies all read it. Stored rows are not rewritten; the state is read from the store, so it holds across a restart. Unit siblings: kept, cancelled, went on by itself, and a session the person started instead while a later wait is kept.
fixed.check_in_the_app: live_check: 1) Run a session until its Claude credential hits a limit (bench: --provider bench-api --api-key limited --env FORERUNNER_BENCH_API_LIMIT_MIN=2). 2) On the project's Overview, Last result reads 'Waits until HH:MM (your API key's limit); then your session goes on.'. 3) Press Cancel in the bar. Without a reload, Last result reads '...; then it runs at your next Start.'. 4) Press Read aloud: the text says the same. 5) In the Inbox, the Update line 'Sea notes: Waits until HH:MM (...); then it runs at your next Start.'. 6) Reload, then restart the app: all three still say it. Bench walk B passed 9 of 9.

fixed.problem: Blocking 4: when the person pressed Start on a project while another project's session ran, the bar said '· then Bird walk', but Bird walk's own line kept saying 'Ready: 1 task waits for your Start' until a reload. Cause: a queued start changes no session, POST /sessions emitted no project event, and the UI re-read the cards on run.changed only when the entry keys changed (a queued start changes only nextProject).
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'd1109-run-visible, run C > GET /running and /health.running say ...' now reads /events and waits for project.changed for Garden site once its start waits and once it is dropped (timed out before). apps/ui/test/run-indicator.test.tsx 'the project's line follows a start that waits behind another session, without a reload' (the line did not change after the frame).
fixed.how: compose's scheduler wrapper emits a project event for the project of a start that is queued or deferred, and of one that cancelPending drops. The wrapper still returns the scheduler's own promise unchanged (sync-gate passes). The UI's run.changed handler (store/context.tsx) re-reads the project cards when the entries or their nextProject change, which also covers polling.
fixed.check_in_the_app: live_check: 1) Start a session on project A. 2) Open project B's Overview and press Start session, then confirm and close the 'Queued' dialog. 3) Within a second, with no reload, B's line reads 'Starts after the session on "A"' and the bar adds '· then B'. Home's row for B says the same. 4) Press Stop ▾ > Stop after this task on A. When A ends, B starts, and B's line stops saying 'Starts after' with no reload. Bench walk A passed 7 of 7.

new_problems: The chat's project facts (packages/runtime/src/conversation/project-facts.ts) and the typed 'summary' command (packages/commands/src/commands/summary.ts:79) still read the stored last result as written, so after Cancel the chat can repeat '...; then your session goes on.'. Both belong to the chat (D3, outside this area). They can call run-indicator.ts resultAfterWait(store, projectId, last_session.ended_at, summary).

A calibration run started by `fr jobs calibrate` while the daemon runs shows on the daemon's GET /running (shared store), but no run.changed frame is sent: the CLI process pokes only its own runtime. The same holds for any session a CLI one-shot starts beside a running daemon.

In bench walk A, while Bird walk's start was queued, its header still offered 'Start session'. Pressing it again would ask for one more start. The status line offers nothing then, but the header button stays (project page header, not this area's).
Stopping the monthly check still records its row as failed (the fixer's note; wording in src/jobs).
notes_for_other_areas: run-indicator.ts: runFoldsOf(store) is the one map of kept run folds per store. compose's RunIndicatorDeps.folds and sessionRunText (the Sessions list's working row) both use it. sessionRunText now folds the whole log, and no longer reads ofTypes(RUN_EVENT_TYPES, 50).

run-indicator.ts: resultAfterWait(store, projectId, since, text) and waitPromiseHolds(store, projectId, since) are the one rule for a stored '...; then your session goes on.'. The promise holds while a continuation or a Start for the reset is kept and no non-intake session of the project has begun since, or once a session with plan.startedBy.by === 'continuation' began after it. Otherwise the text reads summaryAfterWait's '...; then it runs at your next Start.'. It is applied by GET /sessions/:id (since = ended_at), views.ts projectSummary (Last result and spoken; since = last_session.ended_at) and GET /inbox message bodies (since = created_at). run-indicator.ts now imports wiring/billing-pick.ts, so it stays daemon-only, never in the browser build.

CalibrationJobDeps.onRowChanged?(sessionId) is called after the run's session row is inserted and after close(). compose wires it to running.poke through `pokeRunIndicator`, which is set once the indicator is composed.

compose's scheduler.requestStart wrapper now also emits events.emit('project', {id}) for a start whose entry.result is 'queued' or 'deferred'. cancelPending emits it for the dropped request's projectId. The wrapper still returns the scheduler's own promise. The UI (store/context.tsx) re-reads the project cards when a run.changed frame changes the entries' keys or their nextProject.

RunningHealth (api-types.ts) gained an optional check: boolean (true only for the critic's monthly check). runningHealth orders a project's running session first, then the check, then a waiting one. The desktop's daemon::RunningHealth has a check field and state::window_title reads 'Forerunner — the critic's monthly check' for it. d1109-cred-engine (C5) and d1109-cred-screens (C6) should keep this order when they add waiting forms.

RunIndicator.tsx: Stop now's explanation depends on the entry's state. For 'calibrating' it reads 'Stops the check at once. This month's report is not written.'. runTitle names a project's session before the check ('● The critic's monthly check · Forerunner').
compose's run.changed debounce reads clock.monotonic() (lastAt starts at -Infinity) instead of Date.now().

Suggested lines for the session lead (not written here): U-096 check in the app, add 'press Start on a second project while one runs: its line says "Starts after the session on <first>" at once; after Cancel on a waiting session, its Last result, Read aloud and Inbox Update say "then it runs at your next Start."'. CHANGELOG: 'A start that waits behind another session shows on its project at once; after Cancel nothing says a session goes on by itself; the critic's monthly check shows on the bar while it runs.'
